substantive_insights: This was primarily a practical scheduling conflict (religious meal time vs. roommates' sleep/learning schedules), not a values clash between faiths.
Concrete reasons (A's Monday presentation, B's exam nights, C's room proximity) enabled tailored, day-by-day compromises rather than a blanket rule.
Agent D's willingness to pre-cook mitigated the core practical incompatibility (noise from cooking) without requiring others to change their schedules.
